about: Habits that make text read as machine-written, banned from everything the apps show. Checked over the emitted content by tests/test_prose.py and over UI strings by tests/prose-ui.mjs. Patterns are case-insensitive and must mean the same in Python and JavaScript (with the u flag).

rules.advice: Use a full stop, colon, comma or parentheses. Split the sentence if it is doing two things.
A spaced en dash is an em dash in disguise; rewrite the sentence. Unspaced en dashes in ranges (b8–h2, 1–0) are fine.
A spaced double hyphen is an em dash in disguise; rewrite the sentence.
Say the plain thing: important, strong, use, shows, open up.
Drop the honesty framing and state the fact. Everything here is meant to be true.

rules.pattern: \b(it is|it's|it’s) (worth|important to) (noting|note|mentioning|remembering|saying)\b|\bneedless to say\b|\bin conclusion\b|\bat the end of the day\b|\blet’s dive\b|\blet's dive\b
rules.advice: Cut the throat-clearing and say the thing.
"Not just X but Y" is a tell; say Y, or say both plainly.
